## Changes

- Retry a series episode's canonical stream ID when the add-on returns no sources for its Cinemeta episode ID, including episode switches from the player.
- Show whether TorBox confirmed a source as cached and label seeder counts as TorBox or provider observations.
- Send the configured TorBox API key with seeder-count requests. When TorBox does not return a count, fall back to the source provider's count.
- Apply Hide Zero-Seeder Streams to the effective TorBox-or-provider count, including when source sorting is disabled. Keep confirmed cached sources available.
- Retry focus transfer into Settings when the main menu initially retains focus.

## Verification And Limitations

Local unit tests, release lint, and signed 32-bit APK build passed. The APK uses the existing release certificate. Physical TV navigation, live TorBox responses, and playback of a selected episode remain to be verified on-device.
